answer.rationale: memory_57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue by reporting qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. memory_44 links sales assistance to pipeline quality, but omits closed revenue, retention, and economics. memory_73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but does not address discount-driven margins, retention, or long-term sustainability. memory_31 shows a durable activation lift, while memory_86 shows stronger completion and adoption; both are useful leading indicators but lack a demonstrated revenue or qualification link. memory_91 reports only short-term engagement and first-action gains, making its connection to sustainable long-term qualified revenue the weakest. All memories omit experimental design, effect sizes, sample quality, and broader durability evidence.
